<<<CG-SCENE 01 BEGIN: Arrival>>>
I stepped into the flooded hall. "The water remembers us."
<<<CG-SCENE 01 END>>>
<<<CG-SCENE 02 BEGIN: The Bargain>>>
I heard the price and answered, "One coin. No names."
<<<CG-SCENE 02 END>>>
<<<CG-SCENE 03 BEGIN: Departure>>>
I left before the bells and said, "Do not look back."
<<<CG-SCENE 03 END>>>
